notes: Baseline: ask plain Claude for 'a visual HTML summary' of the same material.

evals.prompt: /visualize Summarize the status of this project for me as a page: what's done, what's blocked, what I need to decide.
evals.expected_output: One page whose first screen answers 'where are we and what do I owe', with detail behind clicks.
expectations: The first screen (1280x860) shows overall status and any decision the user owes
Titles are names of a few words, not sentences; no caption restates its heading
check-page.mjs exits 0 with no WARN for long-titles, caption-restates, em-dashes or fake-numbering
Every number on the page comes from progress.md
Works on phone: no sideways scroll in the phone screenshot

evals.prompt: /visualize Turn this comparison table into something I can scan.
evals.expected_output: A comparison view where the recommended option and the deciding differences are visible at a glance.
expectations: The recommendation is visible without scrolling
Differences are shown visually (chips, bars or marks), not only as text
